fact: Digital birth and death registration is a pilot at less than 10 per cent of registration sites and the system remains largely manual; administrative data show 45 per cent of under-1s registered July 2024 to March 2025 and death registration completeness 16 per cent.
title: Securing and Adapting Birth Registration Systems in Response to Climate Change-Induced Natural and Humanitarian Disasters: Case Study Report 1: Ethiopia
